main_text.p: dum obiter curatis, ipsa solent præponi?

At magis forte displicebit quibusdam, opiniones aliorum, quæ interdum examinantur, in partem quæ sequior apparet, sumi, vel absurdis malisve consequentiis nimium aggravari, aut non laudatis appellari titulis. Optarent nonnulli, plus æquo indulgentiores, omnia in benignam partem trahi & boni consuli; quibus ego libens concedam modum illum agendi, quem improbant, a malignitate posse produci: at quin idem a charitate atque a necessitate provenire queat, ipsi, attente si rem considerent, fateri utique cogentur; & eum adeo juxta legem suam, in bonam partem potius quam in malam interpretari debebunt. Dantur enim interdum, ac sæpius quidem quam optandum esset, errores ita perniciosi, & quorum sequelæ adeo sunt noxiæ, ut quotquot se iis patiuntur persuaderi, ad privationem æternam omnis lumi-nis

page.notes: The header "AD LECTOREM." is set in small capitals and treated as the running head. The signature mark at the foot is "* §". The word "lumi-nis" is printed with a hyphen split across the line end. Some words near the right edge and in the margins are faint or show-through and were not transcribed. Page number not printed.
